🇳🇵 Nepal–Tibet Border Avalanche & Flood | 26 August 2026 A major ice–rock avalanche near the Nepal–Tibet border triggered a cascading hazard: a large glacier mass collapsed from high elevation, sending ice, rock and sediment into the Lhende Khola. The debris blocked the river and formed a temporary barrier lake, which then released a powerful downstream surge of muddy water, debris and boulders. 🌡️ Possible factors: glacier instability, melting ice, steep crevassed terrain, meltwater lubrication and possible seismic triggering. ⚠️ Some claims remain unconfirmed, so the exact trigger requires scientific investigation. 🌊 Avalanche → Debris Flow → River Blockage → Dam Breach → Flood #Nepal #NepalFlood #NepalLandslide #NepalAvalanche #NepalTibetBorder Himalayas HimalayanAvalanche Landslide GlacierCollapse GlacialLake BarrierLake FlashFlood DebrisFlow LhendeKhola Bhotekoshi ClimateChange GlacierMelt NaturalDisaster DisasterScience EarthScience 26August2026

🇳🇵 Le 26 août 2026  une partie de l'Himalaya a basculé en quelques heures à peine... Un barrage naturel formé par une avalanche de glace a fini par céder. Résultat : des villages rayés de la carte, des routes emportées, des infrastructures entières détruites à la frontière entre le Népal et le Tibet. Le bilan humain continue d'évoluer, et des centaines de personnes — dont de nombreux touristes étrangers — restent portées disparues à l'heure où j'enregistre cette vidéo. Mais ce qui m'a le plus marqué en enquêtant sur ce sujet, c'est que ce n'est pas un accident isolé. Le Népal traverse une série d'épreuves climatiques depuis plusieurs années : crues, glissements de terrain, fonte accélérée des glaciers... Dans cette enquête, je décrypte avec vous : 🔹 Ce qui s'est réellement passé ce jour-là 🔹 Les causes profondes derrière cette tragédie 🔹 Pourquoi ce pays semble en première ligne d'un phénomène qui nous concerne tous 🔹 Et selon moi, ce qu'il faudrait changer pour éviter que ça se reproduise Un sujet qui dépasse largement les frontières du Népal. 🚨 Urgent Update: Catastrophic Glacier Collapse & Debris Flow Hits China-Nepal Border (Gyirong Port)🙏💔 On the morning of August 26, 2026, a massive glacier collapse in Nepal triggered a catastrophic debris flow and flash floods along the Himalayas, severely devastating the Gyirong (Kerung) Port in Tibet, China, and the Rasuwa District in Nepal. The Cause: A high-altitude glacier collapse in Nepal generated a high-velocity debris avalanche (reaching speeds of ~50 m/s), which swept through glacial moraines and surged into the Donglin Zangbo River, traveling over 20 kilometers downstream. Casualties & Missing (as of Aug 28): •Total: Over 360 confirmed dead and 1,400+ missing across both nations. •Gyirong, Tibet: 3 confirmed dead, 558 missing (including 260 foreign nationals). •Nepal side: Over 350 dead, hundreds missing. Among the victims are many international travelers heading for the Mount Kailash Yatra and trekking in the Langtang region. Rescue operations are underway amid ongoing risks of secondary disasters. #nepal #tibet #gyirongport #breakingnews #himalayas

Journalist Bidhya Chapagain broke down in tears after witnessing the difficult living conditions of people in Ripa village of Humla, Karnali. For decades, residents have been waiting for a suspension bridge over the Karnali River to make everyday travel safer and easier. But with the bridge still unbuilt, locals continue to depend on a tuin to cross the river. Despite changes in governments over the years, the community is still waiting for basic connectivity. Their story is a reminder of how some remote communities continue to struggle for facilities that many take for granted. 💔 Video Credit : Herne Katha #todaysnepal #karnali #sudurpachim

Her Royal Highness Princess Prerana Rajya Lakshmi Devi Shah, the only daughter of His Majesty King Gyanendra Bir Bikram Shah Dev and Her Majesty Queen Komal Rajya Lakshmi Devi Shah, was betrothed to Raj Bahadur Singh on the 10th of January. Before the royal family, the couple exchanged garlands and rings of gold. His Majesty the King then conferred upon the bridegroom the honoured title of "Kumar." Within two weeks, the wedding took place at the palace. The princess wore a red sari woven with threads of gold. The next day, thousands lined the streets of Kathmandu to watch the couple ride in a flower-adorned carriage drawn by four white horses, with the King walking beside his daughter. Members of the royal family, government officials, ministers of state, dignitaries, heads of the security forces, and political party leaders witnessed the grand ceremony #engagement #princesspreranashahsingh #rajbahadursingh #kinggyanendra #queenkomal #queenmotherratna #narayanhiti_durbar#nepalesemonarchist
